title: Leader, Global Commission Operations
teaser: We are expanding our team: As Global Commission Operations Leader, you will oversee the end-to-end sales compensation process, collaborating with Sales, Finance, and HR to design and implement incentive plans. Ideal candidates bring extensive experience in global sales compensation and strong technical expertise in compensation systems.
description:
As the Global Commission Operations Leader, you will be responsible for the end-to-end global sales compensation process. You will bridge the gap between Sales, Finance, and HR to design, implement, and coordinate commission plans that drive revenue, ensure compliance, and motivate global sales teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Design: Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to design competitive, market-aligned commission structures, quota distributions, and SPIFFs (Special Performance Incentive Funds).

Operational Execution: Oversee the monthly and quarterly commission calculation cycles, ensuring 100% accuracy, timely payouts, and adherence to global payroll deadlines.

System Management: Manage and optimize compensation tools, including SAP, Oracle, Snowflake, and Workday.

Analytics & Reporting: Develop dashboards to track commission expenses, forecast payouts, and analyze the effectiveness of sales incentive plans.

Dispute Resolution: Lead a support team to handle commission inquiries, conduct audits, and efficiently resolve payout discrepancies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align with Legal, HR, and Operations to ensure all compensation plans comply with regional labor laws and corporate governance policies.

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: 12+ years in Sales Compensation, Revenue Operations, or Finance leadership including at least 5 years in a global leadership role within a large, multinational corporate environment with a diverse portfolio of Products and Services.

Technical Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in ICM (Incentive Compensation Management) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Varicent, or similar).

Global Expertise: Deep understanding and management of international tax laws, labor regulations, and global payroll compliance standards.

Proven track record of managing complex, high-volume compensation cycles and policies across diverse geographic regions.

Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate complex compensation data into clear, actionable insights for executives and sales representatives alike.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading large-scale system implementations or process re-engineering projects within a global Operations or Finance function.

Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed organizational structure, balancing competing priorities with poise.

Strong project management certification (e.g., PMP or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt) and a mindset focused on Lean methodology and continuous process improvement.

A passion for technology and a deep understanding of how digital transformation can drive operational efficiency in a global enterprise.
